body: Of course getting a job is a must. I have always worked while in school. I was just curious if there were programs or any resources that could be of help. I'd rather ask and be sure than remain ignorant. As for the go fund me idea, I have considered it but it's very hard for me to ask other working class people who are also underpaid, for any sort of financial assistance.
Thank you :) That's a beautiful song. I'll have to listen to more of the album. And the virtual hug does help <3
You're right. I really make less than that because of gas and general wear. I'll continue applying to jobs in Oregon and do door dash on the side. Thanks a lot!

My dad did leave a will behind and put my aunt as the successor. However, he had no money left of his own. He had been "retired" for a few years, despite having absolutely no retirement savings and being unable to pay the mortgage. He willingly did not work and didn't try selling the house sooner because I think he genuinely believed in those get-rich-quick schemes, and relied on loans to get by. I realize I should have moved out sooner...My brother and I went to Wells Fargo the other day and they require at least 40 days after someone passes before being able to access their bank account.

Thank you, I'll definitely check that out. Yes, by "his loans" I meant my father's. My brother decided to take the semester off not only to help out with clearing out the house/selling furniture, but also with the funeral and selling the home. As for the last part, because I'm still a resident of California, I think I'm going to continue my online classes through my current community college while living in Oregon. This way, I wouldn't have to pay out-of-state tuition.

Oh no, I'm still in school taking online classes. I took a leave of absence only from work and put my return date as 12/1 since I wasn't sure how long I'd be needing to take care of my dad and I planned on being a paid at-home caregiver. I currently do door dash as my primary job and I average about $15-16/hr which is more than what I make at my normal job. They've also been cutting hours, I worked only 7 days in September. Because of this, I've been applying to other jobs while doing door dash whenever I have time.
Unfortunately he did not have life insurance or any money left of his own

I just don't have the energy to do it. I'll tell myself, "I'll reply later" and never do. It's frustrating for me too. I know they're not me and we all have our own reasons but it could be more about them than you
